capabilities: Timestamps paragraphs automatically as you type inside timelgr blocks
Scopes timestamping to V1 fenced timelgr blocks or V2 marker blocks
Customizes timestamp format with time and date tokens plus custom prefix and suffix markers
Protects nearby lines from accidental timestamping via relative line protection
Rescans a note to stamp every eligible paragraph on demand
disambiguation: Not a time-tracking or activity-logging tool; it only inserts time and date prefixes on paragraphs inside its own timelgr blocks.
extras: The README states it was generated with AI and debugged by the author; the 1.4.1 changelog appears twice, and only the 1.4.1 changes are documented, not earlier versions.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically insert time and date stamps on paragraphs while journaling.
summary: Automatic timestamping plugin that adds time and date prefixes to journal paragraphs inside configured timelgr blocks.
